item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian forces continue high-intensity strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, killing dozens at a humanitarian hub, an aid centre and power infrastructure, while Ukrainian drones are now being used to transport wounded troops from the front lines. Russia is also equipping its drones with propaganda messages and cyber threats. In the Oleshky area a cease-fire is being exploited by Russian troops to move forces despite ongoing attacks on aid vehicles. Melania Trump is set to host Ukrainian and Russian officials at the White House. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Gunfire damaged tents at the Rafah displacement site as aid teams prepared for winter storms, and families are facing winter in tents on the beach in Gaza. Gaza is converting rubble into power using homemade wind turbines while former Israeli generals are assisting Palestinian olive farmers. Herzog warned Netanyahu of settler violence in the West Bank, and Shin Bet and the IDF knew Hamas’s military chief had gone underground hours before Oct. 7. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Hezbollah is responding with artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. Israeli forces have also built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The conflict has intensified humanitarian strain, with UN warnings that deadly drone strikes are harming civilians, displaced elderly facing basic-needs shortages, and factories struggling to restart after wartime damage. Bread prices have doubled in Khartoum, deepening a food crisis that threatens further hunger. The war produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
